content_zh:
伸出左手使劲拧了一把右手背，“嘶～！”太疼了！
真好！不是梦！我真的重生了！
周园园咧着嘴，望着瞬间红肿起来的右手背，眨了眨眼睛，无声地落下一串串的泪。
她的上辈子，过的太苦了！苦的她一点都不想回忆。
从被“卖”的那天起，从十八岁到三十七岁，周园园一直重复着挨打，逃跑，被抓，再挨打，再逃跑，再被抓，再挨打的套路，直到她死的那一天。
被打得躺在床上爬不起身时，周园园也曾想过，为什么她的命就这么苦？为什么没有人能救救她？
一天一天，一年一年的，周园园终于想明白了。正是因为她没有娘家，所以才没有人会为她出头。自从爸爸妈妈相继去世，唯一的哥哥又被关进了大牢里，她周园园，就没有了做人的权利。
在死的前两年，周园园终于成功逃离了魔爪，跑到H省的一个中等城市。举目无亲又身无分文的情况下，周园园好运地在一家商场找了份清洁工的活干。
当时的周园园，满头斑白的银丝，满脸的皱纹，不到四十岁的人看起来像是五十多岁的老妇人一般。
历尽沧桑的周园园很会做人，她不多话，做事又肯下力气，不是自己的工作也会抢着帮忙。没多久，周园园就和同一个楼层的小姑娘们混熟了。
商场里的收银员和理货员大都是十八九岁的小姑娘，空闲的时候会唧唧喳喳地讨论火爆的网文或电视剧。从那些小姑娘的嘴里，让周园园对‘重生’这个词并不陌生。
上辈子，周园园是个心地善良的人，连一只蚂蚁都舍不得踩，一辈子却尝够了白眼，受尽了欺凌。
上辈子的教训让周园园知道，整个周家，就没有一个好人。就连表面上看起来公正慈祥的爷爷周春平，实际上却是个不折不扣的坏蛋！
她所有的悲剧，都是这些周家的“亲人”们造成的。这辈子，她肯定会好好“问候问候”这些狼心狗肺的。
这辈子，周园园不想再做好人了。她只想要一个家，一个有父母有兄长有外公有舅舅的家。
“园园，你醒了？饿了不？妈给你去打个鸡蛋花。”
赵芸香天刚亮就起来了，去厨房做好公公婆婆的早餐，才有时间回房看看女儿。见到女儿醒了，赵芸香很高兴，急忙转身去为女儿张罗吃的。
“妈妈，别走。”周园园看着年轻俏丽的赵芸香，委屈地唤了一声，就觉得喉咙里梗的厉害，说不出话来。
没有开灯，天刚蒙蒙亮，房间里的光线有点暗。
就算是借着昏暗的光线，周园园还是把赵芸香看了个一清二楚。贪婪地望着年轻时美丽而又不失利落的赵芸香，周园园的心总算落在了实地。

不是做梦，她真的重生了，她的妈妈，不是疯婆子，而是一位俏丽的小妇人。
照时间来算，她的爸爸周志新，此时也还好好地呆在部队里，是一名光荣的军官，而不是前世那位英年早逝还被泼了满身脏水的‘臭流氓’。
“园园，好孩子，不怕，不怕，没事了，啊～！”赵芸香见女儿不愿意她离开，忙走上前，用手在周园园胸前的被子上轻轻地拍抚着。
刚才帮婆婆煮早餐的时候，赵芸香就在担心着还没醒过来的园园，要不是她做惯了那些活，说不定会把婆婆的稀粥熬成了干饭。
“妈妈。”周园园一眨不眨地盯着赵芸香，像是怕眼前的人突然消失了一般。
“哎！”赵芸香清脆地答应着。不知怎的，赵芸香觉得今天的女儿有些粘人。不过，孩子刚受了一场惊吓，有些粘她也是应该的。
“妈妈。”周园园又轻轻地呼唤了一声。听着赵芸香温柔回应的嗓音，周园园觉得自己怎么也听不够。
上辈子的赵芸香，在周志新死后就疯了。之后的几年里，赵芸香时而清醒时而发疯。清醒的时候，赵芸香会抱着园园叫乖女儿，发疯的时候，赵芸香会卡着园园的脖子骂狐狸精。
周园园出嫁的前夕，赵芸香的疯病又犯了。周园园一时没注意，赵芸香就跑出了家门。等周园园在外面寻找了一夜后回到周家，才听说赵芸香半夜里栽进了屋后的水渠里，没了气。
“哎！”赵芸香又应了声。虽然觉得今天的园园有点奇怪，但是，小孩子嘛～不都是喜欢粘人的吗？

content_en:
He stretched out his left hand and pinched the back of his right hand hard, "Hi~!" It hurt so much!
very nice! Not a dream! I am truly reborn!
Zhou Yuanyuan grinned, looked at the back of her right hand that suddenly became red and swollen, blinked her eyes, and silently shed a string of tears.
Her previous life was too miserable! It was so painful that she didn't want to remember it at all.
From the day she was "sold", from the age of eighteen to thirty-seven, Zhou Yuanyuan kept repeating the routine of being beaten, running away, being caught, being beaten again, running away again, being caught again, and being beaten again, until the day she died.
When she was lying on the bed unable to get up from the beating, Zhou Yuanyuan once thought, why is her life so miserable? Why can't anyone save her?
Day by day, year by year, Zhou Yuanyuan finally figured it out. It is precisely because she has no natal family that no one will stand up for her. Since her parents died one after another and her only brother was imprisoned, she, Zhou Yuanyuan, has no rights as a human being.
Two years before his death, Zhou Yuanyuan finally managed to escape from the clutches of the devil and ran to a medium-sized city in Province H. Unaccompanied and penniless, Zhou Yuanyuan luckily found a job as a cleaner in a shopping mall.
At that time, Zhou Yuanyuan had gray hair and wrinkles on her face. She was less than forty years old and looked like an old woman in her fifties.
Zhou Yuanyuan, who has gone through many vicissitudes of life, is very good at being a good person. She doesn't talk much and is willing to work hard. She will rush to help if it is not her own work. It didn't take long for Zhou Yuanyuan to become familiar with the girls on the same floor.
Most of the cashiers and tally clerks in the mall are young girls of eighteen or nineteen years old. In their free time, they will chirp and discuss popular online articles or TV series. From the mouths of those little girls, Zhou Yuanyuan was no stranger to the word 'rebirth'.
In her previous life, Zhou Yuanyuan was a kind-hearted person who was reluctant to step on an ant. However, she suffered enough looks and bullying throughout her life.
The lessons from his previous life taught Zhou Yuanyuan that there was no good person in the entire Zhou family. Even grandfather Zhou Chunping, who looks fair and kind on the surface, is actually an out-and-out villain!
All her tragedies were caused by these "relatives" of the Zhou family. In this life, she will definitely "greet and greet" these ungrateful people.
In this life, Zhou Yuanyuan no longer wants to be a good person. She just wants a home, a home with parents, brothers, grandfather, and uncles.
"Yuanyuan, are you awake? Are you hungry? Mom will get you some frangipani flowers."
Zhao Yunxiang got up at dawn and went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast for her parents-in-law before she had time to go back to her room to see her daughter. Zhao Yunxiang was very happy to see her daughter awake and hurriedly turned around to get food for her daughter.
"Mom, don't go." Zhou Yuanyuan looked at the young and pretty Zhao Yunxiang and called out aggrievedly. She felt a lump in her throat and couldn't speak.
There was no light on, it was just dawn, and the light in the room was a bit dark.
Even in the dim light, Zhou Yuanyuan could still see Zhao Yunxiang clearly. Looking greedily at Zhao Yunxiang, who was beautiful and yet frustrated when she was young, Zhou Yuanyuan's heart finally fell into place.
It was not a dream, she was really reborn. Her mother was not a crazy woman, but a pretty little woman.
Judging by time, her father, Zhou Zhixin, was still in the army and was a glorious officer, not the 'stinky hooligan' who died young and had dirty water thrown on him in his previous life.
"Yuanyuan, good boy, don't be afraid, don't be afraid, it's okay, ah~!" Seeing that her daughter didn't want her to leave, Zhao Yunxiang hurriedly stepped forward and gently patted the quilt on Zhou Yuanyuan's chest with her hands.
When she was helping her mother-in-law cook breakfast just now, Zhao Yunxiang was worried about Yuanyuan who hadn't woken up yet. If she wasn't used to doing that kind of work, she might turn her mother-in-law's porridge into dry rice.
"Mom." Zhou Yuanyuan stared at Zhao Yunxiang without blinking, as if she was afraid of the person in front of her.It suddenly disappeared.
"Hey!" Zhao Yunxiang agreed crisply. Somehow, Zhao Yunxiang felt that her daughter was a little clingy today. However, the child had just suffered a fright, so it was reasonable to be a little clingy to her.
"Mom." Zhou Yuanyuan called softly again. Listening to Zhao Yunxiang's gentle response, Zhou Yuanyuan felt that she couldn't get enough.
Zhao Yunxiang in her previous life went crazy after Zhou Zhixin died. In the following years, Zhao Yunxiang was sometimes sober and sometimes crazy. When she was sober, Zhao Yunxiang would hug Yuanyuan and call her a good daughter. When she was crazy, Zhao Yunxiang would hold Yuanyuan's neck and scold her as a vixen.
On the eve of Zhou Yuanyuan's wedding, Zhao Yunxiang's madness struck again. Zhou Yuanyuan didn't notice for a moment, and Zhao Yunxiang ran out of the house. When Zhou Yuanyuan returned to Zhou's house after searching outside all night, he heard that Zhao Yunxiang had fallen into the ditch behind the house in the middle of the night and was dead.
"Hey!" Zhao Yunxiang responded again. Although I feel that today's Yuanyuan is a bit strange, don't children like to be clingy?
